Timi Called the Shots

Cinematography & Video Production

I film video podcasts, interviews, documentaries, short films, commercials, brand campaigns, live performances and behind-the-scenes content. I can come in as a camera operator or lead the cinematography for the shoot.

Rates and scope

₦350,000 per day in Nigeria · $750 per day internationally

  • Up to 10 hours of cinematography
  • Camera operation and visual execution
  • Pre-shoot discussion and coordination

The day rate covers my work on the shoot. Equipment, crew, lighting, sound, locations, transport and accommodation are quoted separately. Half-days and extended shoots are available by agreement.

Enquire about a shoot

Once we agree on the scope and availability, a 50% deposit secures the booking unless we agree otherwise in writing.
